records.title: Numerical investigation on the influence of nonuniform tip clearance on rotor tip-clearance flow field structure
records.locator: Europe PMC full text of PMC10850596, sha256 0386eae28b94ee5e; abstract; sec. 2.2 design scheme; sec. 2.3 numerical method validation; notation list

access_attempts.outcome: 302 to a JavaScript redirect shell with no article content

access_attempts.route: Europe PMC REST fullTextXML for PMC10850596

records.evidence_grade: A for what it reports: full text, stated method, baseline validated against published experiment
records.finding: Transonic axial compressor (NASA Stage 35), steady RANS in NUMECA with the Spalart-Allmaras model, grid-independent at 2.25 million cells, baseline validated against published experimental efficiency and pressure ratio. Three nonuniform clearance schemes (sine, hump, concave) all run max 0.612 mm / min 0.204 mm against a uniform 0.408 mm prototype. THE VARIATION IS AXIAL, along the blade chord from leading to trailing edge, not circumferential: the paper classifies its own subject as 'axial nonlinear nonuniform blade tip clearance'. It reports stall-margin improvements of 3.102, 2.672 and 0.645 percent. The nonuniform geometries themselves are never measured; only the uniform baseline is compared with experiment.
records.key_quote: 'To control the circumferential leakage area of the tip gap to be the same as that of uniform type and to study its influence on blade tip leakage, three types of nonuniform clearances were designed.'
records.why_matched_controls_is_disclosed: The paper holds the circumferential leakage area equal to the uniform case by construction, and the three schemes share one maximum and minimum so their arithmetic mean equals the uniform 0.408 mm. That is a matched-control comparison of a nonuniform clearance distribution against a uniform one. The IDEA of holding an equivalent clearance measure fixed while redistributing the gap is therefore disclosed in the literature and this project may not claim it as new.
records.what_it_does_not_disclose: It does not address discrete circumferential seams, a ducted fan or small-UAV rotor, deployment-induced defects, or any measured comparison of a nonuniform geometry. The axis of variation is chordwise, so a circumferential seam at equal mean clearance remains outside what this source establishes.
records.limitations: Read in full, but the figures were not inspected as images; geometric claims rest on the text and the stated numeric values.
